item.title: ००१ रामेण हनुमत्कार्यश्लाघनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book VI : Yuddha Kanda - Book Of War

Rama appreciates Hanuma and embraces him after hearing his report.Rama was gladdend that Hanuma did something worthy of a noble servent. Then, Rama reflected upon the problem of how to cross the ocean.

भागसूचना
  1. हनुमान् जी की प्रशंसा करके श्रीरामका उन्हें हृदयसे लगाना और समुद्रको पार करनेके लिये चिन्तित होना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Hearing Hanūmān’s faithful report at the opening of the Yuddhakāṇḍa, Rāma praises his unmatched leap across the ocean and entry into Rāvaṇa’s heavily guarded citadel of Laṅkā.

item.title: ००२ राम-सुग्रीवसंवादः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book VI : Yuddha Kanda - Book Of War

Sugreeva comforts Rama, who is tormented with grief, asking him to keep away from apprehensive mind and to think of ways and means to cross the ocean.

भागसूचना
  1. सुग्रीवका श्रीरामको उत्साह प्रदान करना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Beholding Rāma overwhelmed by despondency, the noble Sugrīva consoles him with wise counsel, urging him to cast off grief now that Sītā’s abode has been discovered.

item.title: ००३ हनुमता लङ्कावर्णनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book VI : Yuddha Kanda - Book Of War

On hearing the words of Sugreeva, Rama requests Hanuma to describe Lanka in detail. Hanuma gives a detailed description of Lanka as he saw it.

भागसूचना
  1. हनुमान् जी का लङ्काके दुर्ग, फाटक, सेना-विभाग और संक्रम आदिका वर्णन करके भगवान् श्रीरामसे सेनाको कूच करनेकी आज्ञा देनेके लिये प्रार्थना करना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Accepting Sugrīva’s reasoned and salutary counsel, Rāma affirms his power to cross the ocean and asks Hanūmān for a detailed reconnaissance report on Laṅkā’s fortifications and garrison.

item.title: ००४ रामेण लङ्काप्रस्थाने मुहूर्तनियोजनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro
**Book VI
Yuddha Kanda - Book Of War**

After hearing the report of Hanuma, Rama fixes an auspicious hour for the departure of his forces to Lanka and perceives good omens. The Army reaches the shores of the sea.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीराम आदिके साथ वानर-सेनाका प्रस्थान और समुद्र-तटपर उसका पड़ाव
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Upon hearing Hanūmān’s sequential report of Laṅkā, Rāma proclaims an immediate march at the auspicious midday Vijayamuhūrta under Uttarā Phālgunī, confident of slaying Rāvaṇa and rescuing Sītā.

item.title: ००५ रामेण सीतास्मरणम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book VI : Yuddha Kanda - Book Of War

Rama recollects the lotus-eyed Seetha and laments much about his separation from her Lakshmana consoles him and there approaches the sun-set.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीरामका सीताके लिये शोक और विलाप
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

With the monkey army encamped by Nīla on the northern shore of the ocean, Rāma confides his waxing grief to Lakṣmaṇa and implores the breeze to touch Sītā and caress him.
